high_level_description: This image captures a serene night scene dominated by the full moon, which is prominently displayed in the sky. The moon is bright and appears to be partially obscured by a cloud, adding a touch of mystery to the scene. The sky is dark, indicating it is nighttime, and there are a few scattered clouds visible around the moon. Below the moon, there is a building with multiple windows, some of which are illuminated, suggesting that the building is occupied or active at this time. The building has a modern architectural style, with a flat roof and rectangular shapes.
